{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: strip commas and convert to float
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA rows (revenue == 999999.99)
df_clean = df[df['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99]

# Now filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers
df_loyal_completed = df_clean[
    (df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
    (df_clean['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = df_loyal_completed['revenue_numeric'].mean()

# Check the count
count_loyal_completed = len(df_loyal_completed)

print(f'Number of loyal, completed orders (after QA removal): {count_loyal_completed}')
print(f'Mean revenue: {mean_revenue:.2f}')"}
